additions.name: Ubitus Maizuru AI Data Center Development

locator.precision: Approximate analyst-selected point inside the specifically identified Ubitus development property at Taira Industrial Park, rounded to four decimals and used only as a campus/property locator. It is not a surveyed centroid, legal parcel boundary, building footprint, whole industrial park marker or operator-published coordinate.
locator.identity_review: Maizuru City explicitly places the Ubitus project in Taira Industrial Park and reports 23,385 square metres. Program registry record 188 identifies Ubitus project parcels Taira 1756-1 and 1754-13 separately from its Tokyo headquarters. The2022 land guide marks the only offered 2.3 ha property with an aerial and named neighbors. That rectangular paved grid matches Esri imagery immediately south of the long gray warehouse, east of the scrap yard and north of the road beside log storage. The September operator image separately shows the grassy paved grid, scrap yard/white shed and long warehouse. No legal parcel boundary or future building footprint is inferred.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Imagery acquisition date and absolute positional accuracy are unestablished. Historical changes and manual visual matching introduce unquantified uncertainty. Pixel resolution and decimal places are not ground accuracy.

status.summary: September 9 operator announcement confirms the named Maizuru development and reports the September 4 ceremony. Retain announced status conservatively: reported commencement language and ritual photographs do not establish a particular physical work stage. September 9 is publication of the fresh project assertion, not initial announcement, permit, operating date or visually verified construction day.

additions.distinctness_review: All 416 baseline sites, 442 projects and 231 original records screened for Ubitus, ユビタス, Maizuru, 舞鶴, HikariX and 平工業団地; no match. Nearest existing site is Kyotanabe 84.7 km away. One site and one development project proposed.
additions.successor_review: Bounded official operator and municipal review found the September 9 announcement as the fresh named-project assertion. Future phased GPU deployments,2027 completion targets and ritual photographs do not establish achieved operations or physical completion.
